```{r}
#| label: theme

clr_ehealth_lab_navy <- "#3C5064"
clr_ehealth_lab_teal <- "#A0C8C8"

theme_ehealth_lab <- function(base_size = 13) {
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    plot.title       = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size + 2, color = "#3C5064", margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 4)),
    plot.subtitle    = ggplot2::element_text(color = "#A0C8C8", size = base_size - 2, margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 12)),
    plot.caption     = ggplot2::element_text(color = "#A0C8C8", size = base_size - 4),
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_line(color = "#A0C8C8", linewidth = 0.3),
    axis.title       = ggplot2::element_text(color = "#3C5064", size = base_size - 2),
    axis.text        = ggplot2::element_text(color = "#3C5064"),
    axis.text.x      = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.margin      = ggplot2::margin(16, 16, 12, 16)
  )
}

```
